title: Curve-decodability ⟹ MCA is char-sum-FREE root counting, so the entire open content is displaced into the close-set cardinality a = the incidence I(δ) (the wall is conserved, not escaped)
evidence: Two parts, both substantiated. (1) The char-sum-free reduction is PROVEN in-tree, axiom-clean [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]: GG25SpreadBound.lean gdiff_zero_card_le bounds the per-coordinate vanishing set by Polynomial.card_roots' (degree-ℓ root bound, EXACT, no Gauss sum / energy E_r); disagree_spread_bound proves (t−ℓ)|T| ≤ t·D by pure double-counting; GG25MCAFromCurveDecodability.all_seeds_close_of_curveDecodable wires it to MCA. No analytic object (M(n), E_r) appears anywhere in the chain. (2) The F4→F3 'identity-level, no-slack' claim is confirmed by exact probe scripts/probes/_407_conn/C051_closeset_eq_incidence.py at the PRIZE regime (proper dyadic mu_n, n=8 and n=16, three proper-subgroup large primes each: q=17,41,73 / q=97,113,193, k=2, q^k brute-forced): for f(α)=nearest codeword, #curveCloseSet == #badScalars (= the line-incidence / I(δ) object of FarCosetExplosion.badScalars_eq_explainable) in ALL 12 cells (e.g. n=16,q=193,radius=14: both =193; radius=13: both =193). The two sets are definitionally {α : dmin(curve)≤D} and {α : ∃ cw within D}, equal for nearest-codeword f. The subtlety the in-tree files flag is real: for an ARBITRARY codeword-valued f (fixed f0) #closeset drops to 2 while true incidence stays 17, with closeset ⊆ bad — so GG25's hypothesis a≤#curveCloseSet becomes substantive precisely as the WORST-CASE close-set count, which IS I(δ). Hence the wall is conserved: the only open input is CurveCloseBudget := a ≤ q·ε* on the worst-case close-set cardinality = I(δ) = F3.
reduced_to: The open content is sharpened to a single named, char-sum-free Prop: bound the WORST-CASE GG25 curve-close-set cardinality #curveCloseSet(δ,u,f) (over codeword-valued f, ℓ=1) — equivalently the affine-line vs weight-⌊δn⌋ syndrome-ball incidence I(δ) (FarCosetExplosion.epsMCA_ge_far_incidence / badScalars) — by q·ε* for far-direction stacks on smooth mu_n. The reduction is verified identity-level (no analytic slack lost or gained), so this is a strictly cleaner restatement of the SAME open quantity, not a new bound.
wall: W-BGK (Paley/line-ball incidence face, = face 4 of the open core, epsMCA_ge_far_incidence). The char-sum-free curve route DOES NOT escape it: the degree-ℓ root bound is exact and lossless, so the open count I(δ) is conserved as the worst-case close-set cardinality. Bounding I(δ)≤q·ε* for thin mu_n is the BGK √-cancellation / generalized-Paley-eigenvalue wall in its combinatorial-incidence form.
honest_note: NOT a closure — C051's own thesis is that this route conserves the wall, and the probe + Lean source confirm exactly that and nothing stronger. PROVEN parts: the char-sum-free reduction (already in-tree, axiom-clean) and the exact F4=F3 close-set/incidence identity (12 proper-subgroup cells). What was NOT shown (and cannot be by this route): any bound on I(δ) itself — that remains the 25-year-open BGK core. Scope of probe: k=2 (small rate, q^k-enumerable), nearest-codeword f gives the identity; the worst-case-f subtlety is exhibited but the worst-case count = incidence is the in-tree FarCosetExplosion theorem, not re-proven here. The verdict is REDUCED (clean restatement of the same open object), one notch better than OPEN because it certifies the curve route adds no analytic slack — useful negative knowledge: an algebraic MCA proof does NOT sidestep the analytic core.
